title: columnea divaricata
intro: Columnea divaricata, commonly known as the Monkey Flower, is a tropical plant species native to Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Columnea divaricata include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in alleviating congestion and soothing irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
